features.title: MainWP product inventory
features.intent: Show separate product tabs with per-site edition and license status. Restrict Unified Shop Extras actions to eligible WooCommerce sites.

provenance.description: Show site-level Lite, Pro and license status for both products, with WooCommerce eligibility gating Unified Shop Extras actions.

scenarios.title: Each tab shows the site's installed editions and activation state

inputs.expectations: Open both tabs with a fixture that has Pro, Lite, inactive and missing packages. Legacy Unified Shop Extras 1.11.1 reports an unconfirmed edition.
inputs.independentOracle: Compare the edition columns with MainWP's synced plugin basenames, versions and active flags.

scenarios.reason: No reviewed Studio environment with MainWP Dashboard site fixtures.
scenarios.recovery: Bind a disposable Dashboard with the site matrix in docs/dashboard-inventory.md.

scenarios.title: A site with missing, inactive, unsupported or unknown WooCommerce has no Unified Shop Extras actions

inputs.expectations: Keep the site in inventory but omit its action controls. Reject a direct refresh for an ineligible site even with a nonce for that site.

scenarios.reason: Studio has no reviewed binding for the signed connection and direct POST nonce.
scenarios.recovery: Use the disposable MainWP Dashboard and scoped site fixtures.

scenarios.title: Refresh displays verified Pro license status for each product

inputs.expectations: Refresh one eligible site per product and display the confirmed Pro license and timestamp. Keep the last known status after a connection failure.
inputs.independentOracle: Compare with the child's signed contract and its locally stored license metadata.

scenarios.reason: Studio has no reviewed binding for a two-installation MainWP fixture.
scenarios.recovery: Bind a connected local child running both product contracts.

scenarios.title: A refresh refuses an unauthorized user or a different managed site

inputs.expectations: Post using a nonce for a different site. Repeat as a user outside the extension permission or with MainWP's allowed-site filter excluding the target.
inputs.independentOracle: The request returns 403 and the inaccessible site's license snapshot is unchanged.

scenarios.reason: The Dashboard fixture and permission roles have no reviewed Studio binding.
scenarios.recovery: Bind a subscriber, restricted administrator and two sites with separate access.

features.title: Single-site installation and licensing
features.intent: Install either approved edition, activate each plugin as a separate operation, and activate eligible Pro child licenses using an explicitly entered or encrypted saved key.

provenance.description: Use signed Lite releases and matching active, licensed Dashboard Pro files. Restrict Unified Shop Extras actions to eligible sites.

scenarios.title: Install each approved edition inactive and activate it separately

inputs.expectations: Install Lite and Pro on an eligible child. Confirm each basename and version, then activate each independently without overlapping editions.

scenarios.reason: The signed catalog and connected Dashboard and Child do not have a reviewed Studio fixture.
scenarios.recovery: Bind disposable MainWP sites and a fixture catalog containing genuine edition layouts.

scenarios.title: Reject Unified Shop Extras onboarding when the target loses WooCommerce eligibility

inputs.expectations: Obtain a valid site nonce, remove WooCommerce eligibility, and retry the action. Confirm installed plugins and customer license state are unchanged.

scenarios.reason: The Studio fixture does not have a reviewed remote state mutation and nonce binding.
scenarios.recovery: Use a connected disposable WooCommerce site and a verified pre- and post-action inventory.

scenarios.title: Persist separate encrypted defaults and site overrides

inputs.expectations: Save defaults and overrides, verify only envelopes are stored, and reject an unreadable assigned override without falling through to a default.

scenarios.reason: The Studio fixture cannot inspect MainWP credential storage.
scenarios.recovery: Use a local Dashboard with synthetic keys and the saved license contract.

scenarios.title: Confirm a Pro license with a fresh signed child read

inputs.expectations: Use a synthetic provider to activate a new Pro installation, then read the child entitlement through a new request.

scenarios.reason: Studio does not have a reviewed fixture for the signed connection and Elite Licenser service.
scenarios.recovery: Bind a disposable fixture with the product contract and an approved synthetic provider.

features.title: MainWP product abilities over MCP
features.intent: Read product status and preview-confirm single-site onboarding and two approved settings through MainWP MCP.

provenance.description: Allow agents to onboard and configure both products via MCP.

scenarios.title: Discover five abilities and return scoped status

inputs.expectations: Use the authenticated bridge to list tools and inventory. Check the IDs and edition states against the Dashboard.

scenarios.reason: No reviewed Studio binding for the disposable MainWP and MCP fixture.
scenarios.recovery: Use the disposable Dashboard and signed Child with both product candidate contracts.

scenarios.title: Verify preview-confirmed product onboarding

inputs.expectations: Install Lite and Pro and activate Pro and the saved fixture license for each product. Verify the child status and confirm results contain no keys.

scenarios.reason: No reviewed Studio binding for the disposable MainWP and MCP fixture.
scenarios.recovery: Use the disposable Dashboard and signed Child with both product candidate contracts.

scenarios.title: Verify the two approved settings through signed Child

inputs.expectations: Enable the pilot module in the child fixture. Preview the opposite value, confirm the preview and verify the persisted value through another signed request.

scenarios.reason: No reviewed Studio binding for the disposable MainWP and MCP fixture.
scenarios.recovery: Use the disposable Dashboard and signed Child with both product candidate contracts.

scenarios.title: Refuse Unified Shop Extras writes after WooCommerce is disabled

inputs.expectations: Deactivate WooCommerce on the child, then request setting reads, setting changes and onboarding. Compare with the existing child state.

scenarios.reason: No reviewed Studio binding for the disposable MainWP and MCP fixture.
scenarios.recovery: Use the disposable Dashboard and signed Child with both product candidate contracts.

scenarios.title: Refuse replayed tokens and modified settings arguments

inputs.expectations: Change the requested value after preview. Confirm that the change is refused. Apply the original value and attempt to reuse its token.

scenarios.reason: No reviewed Studio binding for the disposable MainWP and MCP fixture.
scenarios.recovery: Use the disposable Dashboard and signed Child with both product candidate contracts.
